paper-quiet.intent: The quiet of a game drawn on scrap paper between two people who happen to be nearby. Friendly, unhurried, low stakes; losing costs nothing but the pleasure of drawing the next grid.
anti: not an arena: no announcers, no glow, no dramatic stings, no victory fanfare
not a casino: no chance imagery, no jackpot celebration, nothing that implies luck was involved
not a children's toy: no wobbling mascots or candy gloss; the game is casual, not infantile

mark-ink.where: every placed mark and every grid line

viewing.speed_and_size: the whole board on screen at once, at real play speed
viewing.calibration: sRGB display at standard desktop viewing distance
